title: Horseback ride with picnic
text: I joined this horseback ride. It was a really nice experience. Most of the ride went through quiet countryside paths and the views were beautiful.  The horses were calm and well taken care of and the guide was cool and easy to talk to. I was a little nervous at first since I don’t have much riding experience but it was actually easy. I also had the picnic option, it was  tasty and more than enough food. And of course I took lots of beautiful photos. One of the photos is already the wallpaper on my phone. I’m really glad I did it)
author: 336yuliyas
